title: Set 155

sentences.ko: 애 빨리 재우려고 옆에 같이 누웠는데, 정작 곯아떨어진 건 나였어. 깨 보니까 밤 12시인데 애는 눈이 말똥말똥해서 내 폰으로 게임하고 있더라.
sentences.text: I lay down with him so he'd fall asleep faster, but I'm the one who conked out, and when I woke up it was midnight and he was wide awake playing games on my phone.

alts.text: Lay down with him so he'd crash faster, and nope, I'm the one who passed out. Wake up at midnight, and he's wide awake on my phone playing games.
I lay down beside him so that he would fall asleep more quickly, but I was the one who fell asleep, and when I awoke it was midnight and he was wide awake, playing games on my phone.

sentences.note: **conked out** 는 피곤해서 곯아떨어졌다는 뜻이에요. **I'm the one who** 는 남이 아니라 바로 나였다고 짚을 때 써요. **wide awake** 는 잠이 하나도 안 와서 눈이 말똥말똥한 상태예요.

sentences.ko: 점심 먹으면서 영상 하나만 보려고 했거든. 근데 고개 들어 보니까 벌써 4시 다 됐고, 3시까지 상사한테 보내야 했던 일은 시작도 안 했어.
sentences.text: I was only going to watch one video while I ate lunch, but then I looked up and it was almost four, and I hadn't even started the thing I was supposed to send my boss by three.

alts.text: Was just gonna watch one video over lunch. Next thing I know it's almost four, and I haven't even started the thing my boss wanted by three.
I had intended to watch only one video during lunch, but when I looked up it was nearly four o'clock, and I had not yet begun the task I was supposed to send to my manager by three.

sentences.note: **I was only going to** 는 원래 그것만 하려고 했는데 일이 틀어졌을 때 써요. **I looked up and it was** 는 정신 차려 보니 시간이 훌쩍 지나 있었다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 그냥 싼 청소기 살 걸 그랬어. 이건 너무 무거워서 벽장에서 꺼내기도 싫은데, 싼 거 샀어도 하는 일은 똑같았을 거야.
sentences.text: I really should've just gone with the cheaper vacuum, because this one's so heavy I don't even want to take it out of the closet, and the cheap one would've done the exact same thing.

alts.text: Shoulda just got the cheap vacuum. This thing's so heavy I can't even be bothered to drag it out, and the cheap one does the same job anyway.

I truly should have chosen the less expensive vacuum, because this one is so heavy that I am reluctant even to take it out of the closet, and the less expensive one would have done exactly the same thing.

sentences.note: **should've just gone with** 는 그냥 그걸로 할 걸 하고 후회할 때 써요. **would've done the exact same thing** 은 그걸로 했어도 결과가 똑같았을 거라는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 팟타이 시켰는데 그 대신 피자가 한 판 통째로 왔어. 전화해서 따질 수도 있지만, 솔직히 배가 너무 고파서 그냥 이거 먹으려고.
sentences.text: I ordered pad thai and they brought me a whole pizza instead, and I mean, I could call and complain, but honestly I'm hungry enough that I'm just going to eat it.

alts.text: Ordered pad thai, got a whole pizza instead. I mean, I could call and complain, but honestly? I'm starving, so I'm just gonna eat it.
I ordered pad thai, but they delivered an entire pizza instead. I could call to complain, but frankly, I am hungry enough that I am simply going to eat it.

sentences.note: **I mean** 은 말을 고르며 덧붙일 때 쓰는 말버릇이에요. **hungry enough that** 은 그럴 만큼 배가 고프다는 뜻이고, **instead** 는 원래 것 대신 다른 게 왔다는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 그럼 너 12일 전에는 회사 못 빼는 거면, 내가 이틀쯤 먼저 가 있고 너는 그냥 거기로 오는 건 어때? 그러면 휴가를 다 안 써도 되잖아.
sentences.text: Okay, so if you can't get off work until the twelfth, what if I fly out a couple days early and you just meet me there? That way you don't have to use up all your vacation days.

alts.text: Okay, can't get off work till the twelfth? What if I fly out a couple days early and you just meet me there? Then you don't burn all your vacation days.
If you are unable to leave work until the twelfth, perhaps I could fly out a couple of days early and you could meet me there. That way, you would not have to use all of your vacation days.

sentences.note: **get off work** 는 보통 퇴근한다는 뜻인데, 여기서는 휴가를 내고 일에서 빠져나온다는 뜻으로 썼어요. **what if I** 는 이렇게 하면 어떠냐고 제안할 때 쓰고, **use up** 은 남김없이 다 써 버린다는 말이에요.

reviewed: 1번 casual: konk 는 철자가 틀렸고(conk), 과거와 현재가 한 문장 안에서 어색하게 섞여 있어 짧은 현재형 이야기체로 다시 씀
1번 formal: 원문에 없는 still 이 들어가 뜻이 조금 달라져서 뺌
2번 casual: Gonna watch just one video over lunch, right? 는 말이 어색해서 Was just gonna ~ / Next thing I know 로 고침
3번 casual: 뒷부분이 text 와 거의 같아서 더 짧은 구어로 바꿈
4번 casual: I'm hungry enough, I'm just gonna eat it 은 끊어 읽으면 어색해서 I'm starving, so 로 고침
4번 ko: 팟타이 대신 왔다는 뜻이 빠져 있어서 넣음
5번 ko: 그럼 12일까지 회사에서 못 빠진다면 은 번역투라 자연스러운 말로 고침
5번 note: get off work 는 보통 퇴근한다는 뜻이라, 여기서는 휴가를 내고 빠진다는 뜻으로 쓰였다는 점을 분명히 적음
